senses.gloss: m. (homiletically = חִנָּם; v. ה״א) gratuitous, purposeless act, vanity.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 19a:18">Erub. 19ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="C00654"><he>גיהנם</he></cite>) <he>גיא … שהכל יורדין בה על עסקי ה׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50) the valley which all enter for affairs of vanity (worldly lusts).
